linoleate.definition: n. A salt of linoleic acid.

linoleic.definition:
a. Pertaining to, or derived from, linoleum, or linseed oil;
   specifically (Chem.), designating an organic acid, a thin yellow oil,
   found combined as a salt of glycerin in oils of linseed, poppy, hemp,
   and certain nuts.
